description: Conversation-driven video editing: transcribe, cut, color grade, burn subtitles, self-evaluate — for talking heads, montages, tutorials, interviews. No presets, no menus. Adapted from browser-use/video-use.

required.name: videos_dir
required.description: Directory containing source video files to edit

required.name: api_key
required.description: ElevenLabs API key for Scribe transcription (or set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in environment)

optional.name: num_speakers
optional.description: Number of speakers for diarization (improves accuracy when known)

optional.name: language
optional.description: ISO language code for transcription (auto-detected if omitted)

optional.name: target_length
optional.description: Target runtime in seconds for the final edit

optional.name: subtitle_style
optional.description: Subtitle style preference (bold-overlay, natural-sentence, or custom)

optional.name: grade_preset
optional.description: Color grade preset (warm_cinematic, neutral_punch, none, or custom ffmpeg filter)

optional.name: delivery_spec
optional.description: Optional delivery target (operator/upstream-supplied; defaults to none): aspect ratio, resolution, safe-zone %, caption-style, encoding target. When supplied (e.g. a Meta Reels brief), honor it; source the values from the upstream brief / the canonical Meta reference at frameworks/_shared/reference/meta-video-creative-2025-2026.md. Platform-agnostic runs leave this unset.

distilled_from.rationale: Creative toolkit for conversation-driven video editing. Classified as framework-component (not standalone client-service framework) — reusable inside broader content-production workflows.

components.name: animation-overlay-remotion
components.install: lazy project-local (per-slot npx create-video@latest); never framework-root or global

distilled_from.license: UNSPECIFIED (no LICENSE file; no package.json license field)
distilled_from.note: Remotion library is separately licensed and free for the operator as an individual; this provenance covers only the skills rule-content repo.

system: Python >= 3.10 with requests, librosa, matplotlib, pillow, numpy
api: ElevenLabs API key (scribe_v1 model for transcription)
optional: Remotion (lazy project-local; see components.animation-overlay-remotion and docs/animation-overlay-remotion.md) and Manim for advanced animation overlays
